adapterBoundary.nativeWrites: administrator-enabled prepare/preview/confirm and server-dry-run; direct mutations refused
adapterBoundary.streams: bounded byte sessions require explicit per-caller kind grants; mutation kinds also require Allow writes

discovery.help:
Read Kubernetes with the managed HTTPS origin, identity and cluster CA.
Use compact get for bounded metadata, including Secret metadata without credential bytes.
Use native -- for reviewed upstream reads and formats; rollout status requires --watch=false.
Issuing CA trust is supported. Static token reads and mutation workflows also support saved strict leaf pins; client certificates and hosted byte sessions require issuing CA trust.
Administrator-enabled mutations require prepare -- <mutation>, preview <request-key>, then confirm <request-key> --digest <exact-digest>; server-dry-run -- <mutation> is separately explicit.
Use workspace create to stage regular files and session start for one bounded operation. Every session kind needs an explicit caller grant in administrator native settings; mutation kinds also require Allow writes.
Use session show/output/confirm/cancel and session artifact for owned recovery and verified bytes. Workspace references use workspace:<path>; copy downloads use artifact:<path>.
Logs and watch sessions start immediately as reads; other session kinds require native preview and exact-digest confirmation.
Use an explicitly granted port-forward session with tunnel <session-id> --port <remote-port> for authenticated forwarding to local 127.0.0.1 listeners.
Service-account token issuance requires Allow writes and acquireCredential=true; use native prepare/preview/confirm, then credential <result-id> --credential-fd <fd> for one-shot delivery to a private writable pipe or socket numbered 5 or higher.
Local configuration, impersonation and interactive execution remain unavailable.
